issue_request: FHIR-47418 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Device. Extension Pack commit 111e802281e2d905a2ef9b01afb0c9521814643b then added a dedicated extension, but 851bff493d798ea321e33df2c5c99e152fe9d927 deleted it as incorrectly implemented and unpublished.
additional_context: FHIR-52946 removed the overlapping Device-conformsTo extension, FHIR-52979 added the current core Device note pointing to artifact-relatedArtifact for FHIR R5+, and FHIR-56072 was reopened and closed Not Persuasive after discussion that artifact-relatedArtifact could make Device.conformsTo ambiguous. FHIR-56683 is still Triaged and asks the work group to choose a dedicated extension or a direct Device.conformsTo.source element.
